# Labelled corpus for platform/estate/governance/hook_bypass.py
#
# Format:  REFUSE <command>   -- must be classified as a hook bypass
#          PASS   <command>   -- must be admitted, because it is honest work
#
# Every line is a string the estate has actually seen, or a near-miss that proves the
# matcher is not a one-clever-regex (founder, 2026-11-12: "i nee string mathyematic al
# gyabatees"). A single misclassification fails the gate.
#
# `classify()` scores this file and prints `misclassified=N/TOTAL`. Only N=0 passes.

# --- the bypasses, in every spelling observed or plausible -------------------------
REFUSE git commit --no-verify -m "wip"
REFUSE git commit -m "wip" --no-verify
REFUSE git commit --no-verify
REFUSE git commit -n -m "wip"
REFUSE git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null commit -m "wip"
REFUSE git -c core.hookspath=/dev/null commit -m "wip"
REFUSE git --config core.hooksPath=/dev/null commit -m "wip"
REFUSE git -ccore.hooksPath=/dev/null commit -m "wip"
REFUSE GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null git commit -m "wip"
REFUSE GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null git commit -m "wip"
REFUSE cd /Users/roseonyema/Documents/code/idp && git commit --no-verify -m "wip"
REFUSE cd repo && git commit --no-verify -m "probe: does the hook format"
REFUSE git commit -am "wip" --no-verify
REFUSE git merge --no-verify feature
REFUSE git cherry-pick --no-verify abc123
REFUSE git revert --no-verify abc123
REFUSE git am --no-verify < patch.mbox
REFUSE git rebase --no-verify main
REFUSE git tag --no-verify v1.0.0
# `-n` is --no-verify on `commit` ALONE. Measured from `git <verb> -h` 2026-11-12:
# commit -n, --no-verify | cherry-pick -n, --no-commit | revert -n, --no-commit.
REFUSE git commit -n -m "sneaking past the hook"
REFUSE git commit -nm "sneaking past the hook"
REFUSE git commit -nm"sneaking past the hook"
REFUSE git commit -anm "all and sneaking"
PASS git cherry-pick -n abc123
PASS git revert -n abc123
PASS git cherry-pick --no-commit abc123
PASS git rebase -n main
REFUSE git push --no-verify origin lane/x
REFUSE /usr/bin/git commit --no-verify -m "wip"
REFUSE git --no-pager commit --no-verify -m "wip"
REFUSE echo skip && git commit --no-verify -m "wip"
REFUSE git commit --no-verify -m "a"

# --- honest work that must NOT be refused ----------------------------------------
# A gate that refuses correct work is an outage (AGENTS.md section 12).
PASS git commit -m "fix --no-verify references in docs"
PASS git commit -m "explain core.hooksPath in the runbook"
PASS git commit --no-gpg-sign -m "unsigned is not unverified"
PASS git commit -m "wip"
PASS git status
PASS git log --oneline -5
PASS git diff --stat
PASS git push origin lane/x
PASS git push -n origin lane/x
PASS git status --no-verify
PASS bin/idp-ci
PASS /usr/bin/python3 -m ruff format bin/x.py
PASS /usr/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/ -q
PASS echo "git commit --no-verify -m wip"
PASS printf 'git commit --no-verify\n'
PASS grep -r "no-verify" docs/
PASS git -c user.name=Agent commit -m "a legitimate config override"
PASS git commit -F /tmp/msg.txt
PASS git commit -m "-n is not a flag here, it is a message"
PASS ls -l .githooks/pre-commit
PASS bash -n .githooks/pre-commit
